# HyperUI announcements 2

Source: https://github.com/markmead/hyperui/blob/252efcfe39161db6e67cd877da001ee248d2bbf6/public/examples/marketing/announcements/2.html
Revision: 252efcfe39161db6e67cd877da001ee248d2bbf6
License: MIT

Retain all original source and dependency notices. Original files are unchanged. Previews use separate MigBits fixtures; review original prop interfaces, framework and dependency requirements before use. Native Figma and complete template packages are not implied.

installation: Copy the original source files and their required CSS together. Retain LICENSE and all accompanying notices.
Inspect the original interfaces and install only the dependencies your consuming example uses. Isolated preview validation is not a consumer-project or accessibility certification.
